posts.title: Bruce Schneier's Sophomoric Argument to Nationalise AI
posts.description: In The Guardian opinion pages Schneier, who otherwise is a cybersecurity luminary and visionary, co-authors a staggeringly bad article suggesting that there’s some reason to nationalise major AI labs if, as they are very likely to do, they catastrophically fail as a private business.
